params.text:
The best GAN Python implementation found is the PyTorch-GAN project by Erik Linder-Norén with 45 stars and 193 commits. This comprehensive collection includes multiple PyTorch implementations of Generative Adversarial Networks.

SSH Clone Command:
```
ssh://git@172.26.116.102:2223/eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN.git
```

To clone this repository using SSH, run:
```bash
git clone ssh://git@172.26.116.102:2223/eriklindernoren/PyTorch-GAN.git
```

This project appears to be the most popular and well-maintained GAN implementation on this GitLab instance, with significantly more stars than other GAN projects found in search results.
